title: fraxinus pennsylvanica f. aucubifolia
intro: Fraxinus pennsylvanica f. aucubifolia, commonly known as Green Ash or Red Ash, is a deciduous tree species native to North America. The bark and leaves of this plant have been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Fraxinus pennsylvanica f. aucubifolia include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to induce sweating, reduce congestion, and soothe digestive issues, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as salicin, a compound similar to aspirin.
